laws.rule: Drinking alcohol, taking drugs and smoking are prohibited on all beaches: an offence punishable by a fine, jail or both.
laws.heading: Beach do's and don'ts

laws.rule: Beaches are open from 7 am to sunset; swimming after sunset, driving vehicles on the beach and littering are offences. Swim only between the red-and-yellow flags.
laws.heading: Beach do's and don'ts

local-law.note: Goa's 2019 amendment to the Goa Tourist Places (Protection and Maintenance) Act also bans drinking and cooking in the open at tourist places, with fines reported (by news outlets, not read on an official page) as INR 2,000 per person or 10,000 per group.

culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Drinking alcohol, taking drugs and smoking are strictly prohibited on all beaches, an offence punishable by a fine, jail or both. Don't drive vehicles on the beach, litter or break bottles. Beaches are open 7 am to sunset; don't swim after sunset, after drinking, or outside the red-and-yellow flagged zones.
culture-and-protocol.sacred_or_restricted_places: Keep away from turtle nesting areas. The leaflet covers beaches only, not temples or churches.
culture-and-protocol.cultural_authority: Department of Tourism, Government of Goa.
